notes: Read SKILL.md and references/webhook-delivery.md, webhook-monitoring.md, webhook-rate-limiting.md, webhook-scaling.md, webhook-security.md, webhook-setup.md, webhooks-architecture.md and webhooks-delivery.md in full. The skill guides design of incoming and outgoing webhooks: HMAC-SHA256 signing with timestamp, timing-safe verification, replay windows, idempotency by webhook ID, retry with backoff, DLQ, subscription management, secret rotation, rate limiting and scaling.

Guidance only shapes the user's code. There are no instructions for the agent to run commands, install packages, use real secrets or contact services; fetch() calls and https://webhook-provider.com URLs are sample code.

Minor technical issues to know about. webhooks-delivery.md:7-8 describes HMAC as 'sha256(payload + secret)', but the code correctly uses createHmac. The SSRF check in webhooks-delivery.md:156-172 blocks only localhost/.internal/.local and not private IP ranges or DNS rebinding. webhooks-delivery.md:142-149 emails the new secret in plain text. SKILL.md:345-358 acknowledges with 202 before verifying the signature (processing is still gated on verification). The SKILL.md:79-84 tree has misaligned branches. None of these is presented as a security bypass.
